faq_heading: Port Coquitlam commercial real estate: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. For sale listings only.

Commercial property for sale in Port Coquitlam: industrial buildings and strata units, offices, retail space, commercial land and businesses listed on the MLS®. This search shows properties for sale only; spaces for lease are not included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 for a property that is not listed, or to value one you own.
What sold across the Lower Mainland

Commercial Edge does not break out Port Coquitlam in the figures published on this site. Across the Lower Mainland, 285 commercial properties sold in the second quarter of 2026, worth $1,540.8M: 81 industrial, 56 land, 46 office, 82 retail and other, and 20 multi-family.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).

faq.q: Does this page show Port Coquitlam commercial space for lease?
faq.a: No. The search lists commercial property for sale only. For space to lease, call or text Jared at 604-928-1361 and he will pull the current lease listings for you.
